summary: Design 澄清 commit-driven 维护契约缺口（Test#2 真机+控制器源码核验）：post-UM(LP7) COMMITTED 既有覆盖文件 impactful 改动→游标 advance 但 0 update proposal；只 UNcommitted 工作树改动出 proposal。根因=scanner 用 commit-range(previousHead..HEAD,对)但 FileChangeHandler:275 assessFileImpact 经 getFileDiff='git diff HEAD'(工作树,commit 后空)→零命中→LP7 skip。与 UM 验收#3(committed→update proposal)+完成定义#3/#4(维护走通)冲突。请 Design 裁定:①契约(committed→propose 须修 还是 advance-on-commit/propose-on-working-tree 可接受)②修复形态(assessFileImpact 对 git-head 事件改用 commit-range diff 再套 LP7 零token抑制,调和 CG-5+committed→propose;不重开 LP7)③范围(UM-followup vs redesign)。Design 产契约决策+推荐形态+范围(spec 文档)返回供 intake,不改产品码/不 mutate/不 dispatch。gates U7 维护走通。retire-no-collateral 本身 HOLDS 与本缺口无关。

targetTasks.summary: Design 裁定 commit-driven 维护契约：committed-impactful→update proposal 须修(UM验收#3)还是可接受？修复形态(assessFileImpact git-head 用 commit-range+保 LP7)？范围(UM-followup vs redesign)？产 spec 返回供 intake→控制器派 Plugin 修→Test 再验。gates 维护走通/U7。
